# RecurrentSpikingTopology

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A recurrent spiking neural network architecture whose connectivity pattern is explicitly designed or constrained by a spatial or graph topology, rather than being fully random or uniform. This bridges TCC and iNEST by showing how topology shapes neural dynamics, informing the design of neuromorphic chips with structured interconnects.
